senses.sense_definition: A milky digestive fluid containing fatty droplets, found in the small intestine.

examples.text: The body breaks down dietary fats into <w>chyle</w> within the small intestine for absorption.
Lymphatic vessels transport the <w>chyle</w> from the digestive system into the bloodstream.

senses.sense_definition: An alternative spelling of <w>child</w> representing a specific pronunciation.

examples.text: In some older literary texts, the author uses <w>chyle</w> to mimic a specific regional accent.
The character referred to the young <w>chyle</w> with a thick, non-standard dialect.

traits.comment: Used to represent a specific pronunciation of the word child.
